# disinformation campaign

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:eventTypeDisinformation`](gmeow-eventTypeDisinformation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeDisinformation>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

A coordinated, propagated deception that aggregates many constituent deception events along a [prov:wasDerivedFrom](http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#wasDerivedFrom) / [`gmeow:propagatesFrom`](../properties/gmeow-propagatesFrom.md) propagation chain. At the originating node the held standpoint diverges from the projected standpoint (held ≠ projected) and deceptive intent is attributed; at unwitting intermediary nodes the projected standpoint is sincerely held (held ≈ projected) and the claim is merely untrue — the misinformation↔disinformation boundary is therefore per-node, not a global label. Unwitting propagators bear [`gmeow:roleDupe`](gmeow-roleDupe.md); originating deceivers bear [`gmeow:roleDeceiver`](gmeow-roleDeceiver.md).
